segments.title: One word, many jobs!
segments.say: One word, many jobs! Nikau from Rotorua, New Zealand, shows you.

segments.title: Kia ora!
segments.say: In Māori, he says, Kia ora!

segments.title: It can mean
segments.say: It can mean hello, thank you, or cheers, be well.

segments.title: It's about life and health
segments.say: It's a wish for life and good health. That's a lovely way to say hi!

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to someone you want to wish well, and follow for a new word.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
segments.tiny: A new kid, a new language
